title: Time Clock User: role permissions match the expected set
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned the Time Clock User role.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Time Clock User role's Permission Summary (eye icon on the Roles list).
  2. Check the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Work orders sub-settings, the View mode and the Cross-Cutting Toggles.
  3. Optionally log in as the user and spot-check a few of the role's typical tasks.
custom_expected: The Time Clock User permissions match the expected set: exactly three View-only permissions on — Work orders View, Schedule View and Timesheets View. Everything else is off (no Create & Edit or Delete anywhere; Customers, Parts Department, Invoicing & payments, Reports, Settings, See Financial Data and View and Manage AP/AR Data all off). This role is non-editable.
viu_status: Roles-API-Verified (permission set matches the live role); workflow spot-checks Blocked-UI
evidence: Time Clock User permission set confirmed live via GET /api/roles/{id} (roles-matrix-2026-07-13).
